start_welcome:
Welcome to SQUARES Vault! I'm your personal life-admin assistant.

Send me a photo or PDF of a document (vehicle papers, warranties, bills, IDs) and I'll keep it safe in your own Google Drive. I will also remind you when things are due.
help_text:
SQUARES Vault Help

- Send a photo or PDF anytime to add a record.
- Use the menu below to find things or see what's coming up.

For support, contact the bot admin.
err_group_chat: Sorry, SQUARES Vault only works in private chats.
err_rate_limit: Whoa, slow down! Please wait a moment before sending more messages.
err_internal: An internal error occurred. I've noted it down.
admin_only: This command is only available to the bot owner.
onboarding_consent:
Before we begin, you must be 18+ and consent to the Privacy Policy.

Read it here: https://example.com/privacy

Do you consent?
onboarding_rejected: You must consent to use SQUARES Vault. Use /start to try again.
onboarding_invite_invalid: Invalid or already used invite code. Please try again:
onboarding_tz_prompt: Please reply with your Timezone (e.g. Asia/Kolkata, Europe/London), or type 'skip' to use the default (Asia/Kolkata).
onboarding_tz_invalid: I couldn't recognize that timezone. Try again, or type 'skip'.
onboarding_done: Setup complete! You are ready to use SQUARES Vault.
drive_connect_prompt:
Let's connect your Google Drive so I can save your files.

1️⃣ Open this link on any device:
{url}

2️⃣ Enter this code:
`{code}`

I'll wait here for you to finish.
drive_connect_success: ✅ Google Drive connected successfully! I've created a folder for your files.
drive_connect_timeout: ⏳ The connection timed out. Please try again when you're ready.
